records.process_description: Master’s candidates choose an available topic or propose a self‑selected topic to a supervisor (internal or external). In addition to the supervisor, a faculty member or other person with “Promotionsrecht” must agree to supervise. Topics are listed on unit webpages and in the department’s research‑group/topic lists; past and ongoing theses are published there. To start, upload the Master’s agreement and a 2–3 (30 ECTS) / 4–6 (60 ECTS) page draft concept on Lean Gate; once accepted by supervisor and the Promotionsrecht person it is assigned automatically. Book the corresponding module (GEO/ESS 511 for 30 ECTS or GEO/ESS 510 for 60 ECTS) in UZH’s module booking tool — from autumn 2024 starts are allowed monthly (start = 1st of month); January starters must email teaching-support@geo.uzh.ch for manual booking. Duration: 30 ECTS = 6–12 months, 60 ECTS = 12–18 months. Official timelines, topic lists and guidelines (including plagiarism rules) are on the department pages, the timetable link and UZH’s plagiarism webpage.
